verdict.rationale: Chroma's marketing page claims multi-cloud/multi-region replication for its BYOC/Cloud offering, which is first-party support for cross-zone replication. It is a single thin mention, and nothing in the pack documents a consistency model. missing for 10: documented consistency model (read/write guarantees, replication lag, failover semantics), detailed replication configuration docs, self-hosted replication evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can replicate data across nodes or zones for high availability with a documented consistency model
